title: Books per genre
statementMd:
Count books per genre.

Expected columns: `genre`, `books`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS books FROM books GROUP BY genre;
```
